chunks: And from him, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Abdullah ibn Muskhan, from al-Hasan ibn Ziyad, who said:

Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said: "Marry the free woman to the slave woman, and do not marry the slave woman to the free woman, nor the Christian woman, nor the Jewish woman, to the Muslim woman; and whoever does that, his marriage is invalid."
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on marrying a slave woman to a free woman in Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes the principle of *al-awla bi-al-awla* (the superior with the superior) in marital hierarchy, ensuring that a free woman is not married to a slave while a slave is married to a free woman. He further extends this logic to include *Ahl al-Kitab* (People of the Book), declaring the marriage of a Christian or Jewish woman to a Muslim woman invalid, reflecting the Shia juristic view on the compatibility of social and religious status in polygynous unions.
